items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: I got to study with the great Dave DiCenso... I think that trained me a lot to kind of, you know, just different prep for different styles.

ctx.x: Alex, do you remember if it was a big decision to quit your day gig?
It was. You know music from a young age was always my biggest passion. I, you know growing up I had great teachers, I got to study with the great Dave DiCenso who is an © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

amazing world-class drummer professor at Berklee. I’m from up in New Hampshire. He lived pretty close by so I was able to study with him, Jeff Harrington, another great drummer up there. So I always kind of had that passion like music was it. I also always had that underlying fear of if it doesn’t work out not having any sort of back-up plan and kind of that’s how I was raised is kind of that analytical kind of side.
